quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go west. Next, recover the formless key from the armchair. Then, insert the formless key into the formless chest inside the office's lock to unlock it. And then, open the formless chest within the office. And then, recover the Henderson's style keycard from the formless chest. After stealing the Henderson's style keycard, unlock the Henderson's style safe inside the office with the Henderson's style keycard. If you have unlocked the Henderson's style safe, ensure that the Henderson's style safe is open. After that, take the keycard from the Henderson's style safe. Then, doublecheck that the safe is unlocked. Then, make it so that the safe within the office is opened. And then, take the spherical keycard from the safe. And then, doublecheck that the spherical passageway within the office is unlocked. And then, ensure that the spherical passageway is open. Got that? Good!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to head west. Next, take the formless key from the armchair. And then, insert the formless key into the formless chest in the office's lock to unlock it. After that, ensure that the formless chest is open. Having pulled open the formless chest, take the Henderson's style keycard from the formless chest within the office. After that, make absolutely sure that the Henderson's style safe is unlocked. And then, assure that the Henderson's style safe is opened. And then, retrieve the keycard from the Henderson's style safe. Then, insert the keycard into the safe in the office's lock to unlock it. After unlocking the safe, ensure that the safe is open. Then, retrieve the spherical keycard from the safe in the office. After that, make absolutely sure that the spherical passageway is unlocked. After that, open the spherical passageway inside the office. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
